$comment: The site's Content-Security-Policy (W1.2 of PLAN-design.md): the pages at / and everything under it but /app/, which has its own (security/csp.json). `npm run gen:csp` writes it under /* in packages/site/public/_headers, and the app's under /app/*, which detaches this one first.

Script from the site's own files only: public/site.js (the theme toggle and the landing's demo), the app's /app/theme.js, and on /docs/ the search. The site is built with Astro as static files, and no script of the framework reaches a page: no island, no processed <script>, no client router (packages/site/astro.config.mjs). No 'unsafe-inline', no 'unsafe-eval'; e2e/site.spec.ts holds every page to no inline script. The front page's schema.org data is a script element of type application/ld+json: data, not run, so the policy does not apply to it.

Styles, images and fonts come from the site's own files only: no inline style (Astro writes CSS to files, with inlineStylesheets 'never', the site's components write no style attribute, and Markdown's syntax highlighting, which would, is not used).
No third party: the site's pages make no request to another origin (e2e/site.spec.ts). frame-ancestors 'none': nothing frames the site.

media-src 'self' (W5.2, maintainer's decision for W5-b): the landing's recordings of the app, public/recordings/ (scripts/site-record.mjs). Each is a <video> with controls and preload="none" that plays only when asked, and its steps written beside it.
connect-src 'self': Lighthouse reads robots.txt with a fetch from inside the page (its SEO audit scored 92 without it, W2.1), and the claims page reads /ci-run.json.
